programmes.d: Helck arrives at the Demon Lord's castle and senses a powerful presence; it turns out to be Azudra of the Four Elite Lords, who makes a plea for peace.
Yuko's worried about Momo and dives into her dreams again to get the magical girl to open up. However, is that a good idea? Who knows what could happen this time.
Zeruzeon reveals the kingdom's terrifying plan, so Helck and his friends sneak into the castle to put a stop to it by saving Cless.
Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
Helck is on the verge of being killed; to save the life of his big brother, Cless is forced to make a choice.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.
Helck charges onward, but an army of bounty hunters stands between him and Alicia; she is in horrible shape as she faces public execution.
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
Helck's motivations become clear with an awakening of a horrific truth; Vermilio vows to fight by Helck's side.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.
The winged knights continue attacking Castle Thor to level themselves up further; Asta keeps snooping for information in the human realm.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
Zeruzeon leads the winged knights in an assault on the newly rebuilt castle; humans and demons become locked in combat.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.
Hyura and Edil battle it out at Castle Thor while a strange relationship starts between them; Mikaros is confronted by Azudra and reveals a past grudge.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
Raphael's army attacks a demonkin outpost when Helck and Vermilio arrive; Raphael determines Vermilio is Helck's newfound source of support.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.
Helck faces off with his former friend, Alicia; Vermilio can't help but be concerned about Helck as she continues to fight with Raphael.
Ushio finds someone imprisoned in the basement of his family's shrine, and accidentally releases its aura, attracting thousands of monsters.
They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Tora begins following Ushio to school; Asako, Mayuko and the girls of the library club are attacked by a stone monster.
Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.
Ushio meets the daughter of a painter he likes and wants her to model for him.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.
Workers accidentally release a family of malicious demons bent on revenge.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.
A powerful exorcist seeks the monster that murdered his wife and child, and he's convinced that Tora is the yokai he seeks.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.
An ocean spirit asks Tora to help destroy a powerful serpent demon, and after he gets eaten, Tora asks Ushio for help.
As Kanie continues to create change throughout the park, Sento feels as though she isn't helping enough. However, as a storm threatens to flood the park, Sento takes charge!
Ushio presses his father for information about his mother; Ushio's father is given the order to kill Tora.
Kanie's new ticket prices are having a not-so-surprising backlash - the park's broke. Desperate, he, Sento, and a few of the mascots head to a cave rumored to hide treasure.
Ushio and Tora's plane is attacked by a yokai that not even Tora may be able to defeat.
Aratake, the strongest delinquent in school, can't believe Naoya, a former gang leader, has gone soft; the gang abducts Yukimura, whom they mistake for Naoya's girlfriend.
A mad yokai goes on a killing spree and his siblings beg Ushio to kill their brother.
The Student Council plans an open house at Seika High to boost female enrollment. However, a girl-hating freshman, Soutarou, goes to extreme measures to derail their efforts.
A girl who cares for a captive yokai needs Ushio's help to free it.
Soutarou is shocked to find that Misaki was able to outlast his little game. Misaki has a special punishment in mind for the freshman at the upcoming Open House.
Ushio sees a vision of Asako and Mayuko getting attacked by a mirror demon.
It's the summer vacation, and the Maid Latte crew has been invited to Satsuki's sister's beach resort. Aoi tags along, too, but why did Satsuki bring Usui?
On the road to uncovering the truth about his mother, Ushio is attacked by a massive horde of demons, all hell-bent on ripping him apart.
It's the second day of vacation, and Aoi needs Misa's help to win the beach volleyball tournament! The winners are crowned Beach Prince and Princess, so why is Usui competing?
Facing imminent death, Ushio prepares himself for the worst.
The Miyabigaoka Student Council aims to buy out Maid Latte and replace it with a butler cafe. The only way for Misa to stop this is to enter the footman auditions in disguise.
Ushio is intercepted by a young woman, one of four who've been trained to inherit the Beast Spear; faced with the truth, Ushio must decide whether to hand over the spear to its rightful owner.
Usui and Misaki must cooperate to succeed in the second round of the footman auditions, but before the third round begins, disaster strikes.
Nagare comes to terms with Ushio as the wielder of the spear; tensions rise as Moritsuna, the most favored and most powerful successor of the Beast Spear, arrives.
Yukimura's sister loves playing princess but her brother's not princely enough. She's smitten by Prince Usui, so Yukimura arranges a date for them to regain her favor.
Determined to battle the yokai possessing Moritsuna, Ushio plans to use the Beast Spear to enter a human's body.
Misaki orders the sports clubs to clean up their club rooms. Meanwhile, a transfer student, Hinata Shintani, arrives and irks Misaki with his childish behavior and gluttony.
As Ushio loses more of his soul, the spirit of the Kohamei Sect founder offers the only solution to stop his rampage.
It's the school field trip, and the class has been tricked into hard work at a temple. The girls are curious about Misa and Hinata, while she has to keep him and Usui apart.
Tora and the girls look to restore Ushio; Ushio's life, and everyone else's, falls on Asako's shoulders.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
A monster inside the cave transports Ushio and Tora to ancient China; Ushio meets a young Jie Mei, the sister of the Beast Spear's creator.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Ushio, Jie Mei and Giryo are left shaken after the encounter with Hakumen no Mono; the true nature of the spear comes to light.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.
Ushio's homecoming is disturbed when the fourth successor, Kirio, appears; an avatar of Hakumen no Mono attacks.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.
Kirio leads an attack on Ushio and takes the Beast Spear; the circumstances of Kirio's birth are revealed.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
With no help available, Ushio must battle Kirio and his "mother" by himself.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
Tora decides to haunt Mayuko for the day, but she is lured into a trap at a shopping center.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.
Scientists target Ushio and Tora, and Asako is caught in the crossfire.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
Shigure and the JSDF close in on the lab as Ushio and Tora try to rescue Bal; Asako works with the H.A.M.M.R. scientists.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
Everyone's memories are erased; Ushio is devastated when he discovers that no one knows who he is.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
As Jie Mei's spirit appeals to the yokai to spare Mayuko's life, Ushio and Tora try to stop their plans.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
Ushio's meeting with Hyou is interrupted by a pack of yokai.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
After being betrayed by a close ally, Ushio is summoned by the surviving H.A.M.M.R. scientists.
When challenging an archnemesis to a duel, please make sure they do not mistake it as an invitation to hang out. It's awkward for everyone involved.
Ushio and Tora rush to save his mother; Nagare and Tora face off; Ushio tries to get the JSDF to call off the attack.
Mikan realizes something - she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo's sister! Maybe.
Ushio prepares to meet his mother; the yokai of the East and West clash.
After hearing that Lilith has been sealed for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.
As the battle against Hakumen begins, Ushio loses his mind to the spear.
Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura, but somehow ends up getting a part-time job instead!
Ushio dreams of a child born on the night a star destroyed an ancient village and comes to realize Hakumen's origin.
Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe. However, Momo is vehemently opposed to it!
As Tora squares off against Hakumen, Tora's memory is restored to the people who've forgotten him.
When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda! Meanwhile, Momo takes a certain action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.
Humans and yokai unite behind Ushio to fight Hakumen; Saya opens the gates to the underworld for help; Hyou faces Guren in a fight to the death.
Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out far more hectic than intended. She tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow...
Mayuko tries to revive a wounded Tora.
Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them. She'll need help to make something tasty, so Shamiko visits a certain address.
The humans join the fight at sea; Ushio and Tora find themselves at the mercy of Hakumen's most dangerous form.
Momo is stuck in her darkness form! Without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys whatever she touches.
Hakumen, driven mad with hatred, hunts down the spear; Ushio and Tora make an impossible choice.
Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination. Special training in Lilith's sealed space will help her. Maybe.
The Demon Lord is defeated by a human hero; to find his replacement, the demon kin hold a competition; Helck, a human and mortal enemy, is among the participants.
